domains.scope: Cloudflare account daily Neuron allowance across Workers AI models
domains.modelDimension: Text-generation request limit defaults to 300 RPM; some models require Workers Paid and are excluded from Workers Free regardless of neuron balance
domains.telemetry: Dashboard provides Neuron usage; 3036/429 means allowance exhausted, 3040/429 means temporary out of capacity, 5035/403 means paid-only model.
domains.commercialBasis: Workers AI is a cloud service used inside customer applications; exact plan and third-party model terms still require qualification.
domains.billingRisk: Workers Paid bills Neurons beyond 10,000/day. Preserve verified hard-stop/overflow protection; Workers Free hard-stops. Do not infer a no-charge route from the included allocation on a paid plan alone.
